note: B34-DEF-001. This checkout (an Android mobile integration branch) is explicitly NOT the canonical backend deployment authority, even though it carries its own copy of supabase/functions. scripts/deploy-edge-functions.js's Step 1 checks this file's role and refuses to run because it is not 'backend-deployment-authority'. See docs/BACKEND_DEPLOYMENT_AUTHORITY.md and, on the canonical branch, docs/staging-rebuild/backend-authority-manifest.md.
